methodology: Page-by-page full-text reading completed for all 95 physical pharmacology MDX pages, including desmopressin and short indexes/stubs. fullTextRead records actual entire-content reading; SHA256 identifies that saved text. Primary guideline/label and high-impact evidence checks are prioritized over adding small studies.
